reflections.notebook: Opponent relies on Azumarill + Mudsdale attrition; Azumarill uses Expert Belt Aqua Jet as primary low-HP execution tool, bypassing Intimidate and speed control. Mudsdale functions as a bulky Leftovers pivot with Body Press, stalling through Protects and mitigating stat drops. Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks status, forcing raw damage checks. Future: prioritize early Azumarill removal, avoid 1v2 endgames, and consider Corviknight/Farigiraf for better defensive synergy against slow, bulky Water/Ground compositions. Protect chains are high-risk; pivot to offensive pressure when isolated.
